meaning: n. 勞動；勞動力；工人 v. 努力
example: The harvest requires extra local labour, so students often pick fruit in the surrounding orchards during the long summer. (收成需要額外本地勞動力，因此學生常在漫長夏季到周邊果園採水果。)
The government set a strict quota on the number of foreign workers allowed in. (政府對允許入境的外籍勞工人數訂下嚴格配額。)

meaning: adj. 漠不關心的；不煩惱的
example: She seemed surprisingly unconcerned about the final failed exam, although her parents were clearly and genuinely deeply worried. (她對期末考不及格似乎出奇地漠不關心，儘管父母既明顯又真切地深深擔憂。)

meaning: v. 猜想；懷疑 n. 嫌疑犯
example: Investigators suspect that the fire started in an empty warehouse nearby last night. (調查人員懷疑火災是昨晚在附近一間空倉庫開始的。)
The rapid deterioration of the old bridge forced the council to close it. (舊橋迅速惡化，迫使議會封閉它。)

meaning: adj. 三部分的；三倍的 v. 增至三倍
example: The price of the small flat has tripled since the new metro line opened. (新地鐵線開通後，這間小公寓的價格漲了三倍。)
World leaders strongly condemned the attack and called for an immediate ceasefire. (世界領袖強烈譴責這起攻擊，並呼籲立即停火。)
Great works of art can transcend language and touch people from different cultures. (偉大的藝術作品能超越語言，打動不同文化的人。)
The cumulative effect of small daily savings can be surprisingly large over years. (每天小額儲蓄的累積效果，多年下來可能大得驚人。)
Draw a horizontal line across the page and label the two ends. (在頁面上畫一條水平線，並標示兩端。)
The village houses are built of adobe, which keeps them cool in summer. (村裡的房子用泥磚建造，夏天能保持涼爽。)

meaning: vt. 證明；保證；頒發合格證書
example: An independent lab must certify that the water is safe to drink. (必須由獨立實驗室證明這水可安全飲用。)
Loud noise causes a high level of arousal that makes concentration difficult. (巨大噪音會引起高度亢奮，使人難以專心。)
His gambling addiction drained the family savings, and he finally quietly sought help from a small local clinic. (他的賭博成癮耗盡家庭積蓄，最後他悄悄向一家小型當地診所求助。)
The neighbour alleged that the delivery driver had damaged her gate, but no clearly useful camera footage existed. (鄰居宣稱送貨司機撞壞她的大門，但沒有清楚可用的監視影像。)

meaning: adj. 兩棲的；水陸兩用的
example: The small amphibious frog moves quickly between the nearby pond and open meadow, escaping predators in both habitats. (這隻小型兩棲青蛙迅速往返附近池塘與開闊草地，在兩種棲地都能避開掠食者。)
The hot-air balloon ascended slowly into the calm morning, giving passengers a wide clear view of the patchwork fields below. (熱氣球慢慢升入平靜的早晨，讓乘客清楚遼闊地俯瞰下方拼布般的田野。)
The scientist asserted that the diet was safe, yet several independent tests later found clear and serious problems. (這名科學家斷言該飲食法安全，但幾項獨立測試後來發現明顯的嚴重問題。)
The airline assured passengers that their luggage would eventually arrive, but it reached an entirely wrong distant city. (航空公司向乘客保證行李會送達，但它卻被送到完全錯誤的遙遠城市。)

meaning: vt. 使困惑；難倒 n. 擋板
example: The strange clue completely baffled the detective, who had solved every other single case in the local district. (這個奇怪線索讓警探完全困惑，他過去破過當地每一件其他案子。)
The new recycling rules entirely bewildered many residents, so the council printed a clear simple illustrated paper guide. (新回收規則讓許多居民完全困惑，因此市議會印了一份清楚簡單的圖文紙本指南。)
Protecting biodiversity is essential for healthy ecosystems and stable global food supplies. (保護生物多樣性對健康生態系和穩定的全球糧食供應至關重要。)

meaning: n. 花蕾；葉芽 v. 發芽；萌芽
example: A single rose bud finally opened quietly beside the gate, promising welcome colour after a long grey winter. (一朵玫瑰蓓蕾終於在門旁悄悄綻放，在漫長灰暗的冬季後帶來喜人的色彩。)
Sailors once relied on celestial navigation, using stars to cross vast open oceans without any early modern instruments. (水手曾依靠天體導航，用星星橫越廣闊大洋，沒有早期現代儀器。)
The designer chose a bold bright combination of yellow and blue, making the small shopfront instantly quite memorable. (設計師選用鮮明又大膽的黃藍組合，讓小店面立刻令人難忘。)
Tourism has had a damaging impact on the coral reef, despite strict new rules limiting local visitor numbers. (觀光對珊瑚礁造成破壞性影響，儘管有嚴格的新規定限制當地遊客人數。)

meaning: v. 重新開始；恢復；更新；續借
example: He forgot to renew his passport, so the entire family trip abroad had to be postponed until spring. (他忘了更新護照，因此整趟家族出國旅行必須延到春天。)

meaning: v. 鞠躬；彎腰 n. 弓；蝴蝶結
example: The shy child bowed nervously, then hurried back to her seat without saying a single word to anyone. (害羞的孩子緊張地鞠了一躬，然後一句話也沒說就匆匆回到座位。)
The young challenger defeated the reigning champion easily, surprising everyone who had surely quite expected a one-sided match. (年輕挑戰者輕鬆擊敗衛冕冠軍，讓原本幾乎篤定預期一面倒比賽的所有人驚訝。)
The builders unexpectedly discovered heavy dense clay deep in the subsoil, which slowed foundation work for several weeks. (建築工人意外在底土深處發現厚重黏土，使地基工程延誤了好幾週。)
The large bread bin was already empty again, because the children had simply eaten absolutely everything before breakfast. (大麵包箱又空了，因為孩子們早餐前就把所有東西吃光了。)
The smell of wood smoke evokes memories of winter evenings at my grandmother's house. (柴火的煙味喚起我在祖母家度過冬夜的記憶。)

meaning: v. 振翅；拍打（翅膀）；飄動；晃動
example: Colourful flags flutter above the busy square during the annual spring festival. (一年一度的春節期間，繽紛旗幟在熱鬧廣場上方飄動。)
Front-line firefighters worked bravely through the night, protecting houses while the wildfire spread rapidly across the nearby hills. (第一線消防員勇敢徹夜工作，在野火迅速蔓延附近山丘時保護房屋。)

meaning: adj. 絕望的；拼命的；極度渴望的；危急的
example: He was desperate for a job after months of searching, so he finally accepted the modest low-paid position. (找工作數月後他極度渴望有份工作，因此終於接受了那份待遇不高的職位。)
The museum provides ramps so visitors in wheelchairs can reach every gallery. (博物館提供坡道，讓坐輪椅的訪客能到達每個展廳。)

meaning: n. 齒輪；傳動裝置；用具 vt. 調整
example: He changed into low gear before driving up the steep mountain road. (他在開上陡峭山路前換到低速檔。)

meaning: n. 樂隊；群；波段 vt. 用帶綁紮
example: A small jazz band played happily at the wedding reception, keeping guests dancing until the lights finally dimmed. (一支小型爵士樂隊在婚禮上愉快演奏，讓賓客跳舞到燈光終於變暗。)

meaning: v. 飼養；繁殖；培育 n. 品種
example: Farmers in this cool valley breed sheep for wool rather than meat. (這個涼爽山谷的農民養羊是為了羊毛，而非肉品。)

meaning: adj. 可理解的；明白易懂的；清楚的
example: His explanation was clear and intelligible even to readers without a science background. (他的解釋清楚易懂，即使沒有科學背景的讀者也明白。)
The essence of the proposal is to make public transport cheaper and more reliable. (這項提案的本質是讓公共運輸更便宜、更可靠。)

meaning: v. 使易受影響；使偏愛；使易患病
example: A family history of diabetes may predispose people to the illness, although daily diet still remains very important. (糖尿病家族史可能使人容易罹患此病，儘管日常飲食仍非常重要。)

meaning: vt./n. 陳列；展覽；顯示；表現
example: The quiet shop displays handmade local pottery in the window, attracting visitors who rarely enter such small stores. (這家安靜的店在櫥窗陳列手工當地陶器，吸引平常很少走進這類小店的訪客。)
The famous athlete retired at thirty, then successfully started coaching young runners at a small local athletics club. (這位知名運動員三十歲退休，之後成功在小型地方俱樂部開始指導年輕跑者。)
We enlarged the photograph and hung it above the living room sofa. (我們把照片放大，掛在客廳沙發上方。)
Landslides often occur on this road after several days of heavy rain. (這條路在連日大雨後經常發生土石流。)
The report relates the decline in fish to pollution from nearby factories. (這份報告把魚群減少與附近工廠的汙染連結起來。)

meaning: adj. 光禿禿的；赤裸的；荒涼的；完全的
example: The bare hospital room was stark and cold, offering none of the comfort that patients truly needed most. (光禿的病房荒涼又寒冷，完全沒有提供病人真正需要的安慰。)
The school informed all parents about the sudden closure, sending messages quickly enough for them to arrange childcare. (學校通知所有家長停課消息，訊息送得夠快，讓他們能安排托育。)

meaning: v. 暫停；躊躇；停住 n. 暫停
example: Construction halted briefly after angry residents complained, but work resumed before any written formal proper agreement was reached. (居民憤怒抗議後工程短暫停住，但在達成任何正式書面協議前又復工了。)
The injury damaged a nerve in his hand, leaving two fingers numb. (傷勢損害他手部的一條神經，導致兩根手指麻木。)

meaning: n. 最後期限；截止日期
example: The novelist missed the final deadline again, forcing the publisher to delay the entire book publication until autumn. (小說家又錯過最後期限，迫使出版社把整本書延到秋天出版。)
The accident left him unable to move his right lower limb for months. (那場意外讓他好幾個月無法移動右下肢。)
She rarely discusses politics at home, preferring to keep that sphere entirely separate from her own working life. (她在家很少談政治，寧可把那個領域與自己的工作生活完全分開。)
The exhibition clearly explains the evolution of birds from small feathered dinosaurs. (展覽清楚說明鳥類如何從小型有羽毛恐龍演化而來。)

meaning: adj. 適當的；相配的；合適的；適宜的
example: This soil is not suitable for growing rice because it drains too quickly. (這種土壤不適合種稻，因為排水太快。)
Many sports beverages contain surprisingly large amounts of hidden sugar, so health experts always advise reading the label carefully. (許多運動飲料含有驚人大量的隱藏糖分，因此健康專家總是建議仔細閱讀標籤。)
The annual influenza vaccine is offered free to elderly residents, greatly reducing serious illness during the cold winter months. (年度流感疫苗免費提供給年長居民，大大減少冬季的重症。)

meaning: adj. 犯罪的；刑事的 n. 罪犯
example: The police opened a criminal investigation into the misuse of public funds. (警方對濫用公款展開刑事調查。)

meaning: adv. 毋庸置疑地；確鑿地
example: The new library is undoubtedly the most popular public building in town. (這座新圖書館無疑是鎮上最受歡迎的公共建築。)
An avalanche blocked the only road to the ski village for three days. (一場雪崩使通往滑雪村的唯一道路中斷三天。)
Social media can deepen alienation among teenagers, especially when daily online comparisons increasingly replace genuine face-to-face conversations entirely. (社群媒體可能加深青少年的疏遠感，尤其當每日的線上比較日益取代真誠的對話。)
Thick dust had accumulated on the shelves while the house stood empty. (房子空著期間，架上積了厚厚的灰塵。)

meaning: v. 傳送；傳染；傳播；傳輸
example: The old radio tower still transmits a weak signal, so nearby villages clearly receive only two radio stations. (舊廣播塔仍傳送微弱訊號，因此附近村莊清楚只能收到兩個電台。)

meaning: n. 身分證明；識別；鑑定
example: All visitors must show valid identification before entering the main government building. (所有訪客進入政府大樓前都必須出示有效身分證明。)

meaning: v. 徘徊；閒逛；漫步；走神
example: We wandered through the narrow old streets and discovered a tiny bookshop. (我們閒逛狹窄的老街，發現了一間小書店。)

meaning: adj. 古典的；傳統的；經典的
example: The museum was built in a classical style, with tall columns and wide stone steps at the front. (這座博物館以古典風格建造，前方有高聳圓柱和寬闊石階。)

meaning: n. 濫用；虐待；辱罵 v. 濫用
example: The free helpline offers confidential support to victims of abuse, with trained staff available every day around the clock. (免費求助專線為受虐受害者提供保密支持，受訓人員每天全天候待命。)

meaning: adj. 假的 n. 假貨；騙子 v. 偽裝
example: The market was closed after police found fake medicines on sale there. (警方發現市面販售假藥後，市場被關閉。)

meaning: vt. 合併；納入；包含；吸收
example: The new building design incorporates recycled materials and uses far less energy. (新建築設計納入回收材料，並大幅減少能源使用。)

meaning: vt. 追蹤；追查 n. 痕跡；微量
example: Local health workers traced everyone who had potentially contacted the infected traveller. (衛生人員追查所有最近接觸過這名染病旅客的人。)

meaning: vt. 傳送；運送；表達；傳遞
example: The painting conveys a deep sense of loneliness, although its colours are unexpectedly warm, bright and quite cheerful. (這幅畫傳達深沉的孤獨感，儘管色彩意外溫暖、明亮又相當愉快。)
A low stone wall clearly marks the boundary between the two farms. (一道低矮石牆標示兩座農場之間的分界線。)
To be frank, the film was too long, slow and rather confusing. (坦白說，這部電影太長，而且相當混亂。)
Staff received a small bonus for finishing the project ahead of schedule. (員工因提前完成專案而獲得少量獎金。)

meaning: adj. 好戰的；好鬥的；激進的 n. 激進分子
example: Angry militant farmers quickly blocked the main road, demanding higher prices for their local dairy milk and grain. (憤怒的激進農民迅速封鎖主要道路，要求提高他們當地乳品和穀物的價格。)
Thousands of refugees risk starving unless aid quickly reaches the remote camp before winter closes the mountain roads. (數千名難民面臨餓死的風險，除非援助迅速送達偏遠營地，趕在冬季封閉山區道路之前。)

meaning: v. （使）復原；更新；（使）精神振作
example: A short walk and a glass of water refreshed her before the long meeting. (短暫散步和一杯水讓她在漫長會議前恢復精神。)

meaning: n. 營養障礙；營養不良
example: Research into muscular dystrophy remains still seriously underfunded, despite affecting many thousands of families across the whole country. (肌肉萎縮症研究仍嚴重缺乏經費，儘管它影響全國各地數以千計的家庭。)

meaning: v. 有益於；有助於；導致
example: A calm quiet room and regular breaks conduce to better concentration, especially during long weeks of exam preparation. (安靜的房間和規律休息有助於提升專注力，尤其是在漫長的考試準備週。)

meaning: n. 領事館；領事職位；領事任期
example: The consulate refused his student visa application, explaining clearly that one single required document was apparently still missing. (領事館拒絕他的學生簽證申請，清楚說明有一份必要文件顯然仍缺失。)
Harmful bacteria can contaminate food during raw food preparation, so cooks should always wash their own hands thoroughly. (有害細菌可能在生食製備過程中汙染食物，因此廚師應始終徹底洗手。)
The main demerit of the plan is constant noise, although it would clearly reduce average journey times considerably. (這項計畫的主要缺點是持續噪音，儘管它明顯能大幅縮短平均行車時間。)

meaning: n. 命名；單位；宗教派別
example: The old church split into several denominations, yet the small local congregation still quietly shared one community hall. (這座老教堂分裂成幾個教派，但小型地方會眾仍低調共用一間社區禮堂。)

meaning: n. 擾亂；打擾；騷亂；煩惱
example: Any sudden disturbance at night always wakes the baby, so the neighbours carefully keep their music extremely low. (夜間任何突然的擾動總會吵醒寶寶，因此鄰居非常小心地把音樂開得極小。)

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的；使人快樂的
example: The board game was surprisingly enjoyable, keeping the whole family entertained through a long rainy afternoon stuck indoors. (這款桌遊意外地令人愉快，讓全家在漫長雨天的室內時光都玩得開心。)
He carefully checked the expiry date on his passport, discovering it would lapse during the upcoming long trip. (他仔細查看護照的有效期限，發現它會在即將到來的長途旅行期間到期。)
Small currency fluctuations make exporting difficult, because prices can suddenly change sharply even within the space of a single week. (小幅匯率波動就讓出口變得困難，因為價格甚至可能在一週內突然劇烈變動。)
The frequency of local buses to the village has now fallen sharply, leaving many elderly residents increasingly isolated. (前往村莊的當地公車班次已大幅減少，讓許多長者日益孤立。)
The tiny hamlet attracts many artists each summer, who paint the quiet local harbour and old stone cottages. (這座小村莊每年夏天吸引許多藝術家，他們畫下安靜的當地港灣和古老石屋。)
The evidence was clearly incomplete; hence, the committee postponed its final decision until further laboratory tests were finished. (證據明顯不完整；因此，委員會把最終決定延到進一步實驗室檢驗完成後。)

meaning: adj. 不充分的；不適當的
example: The new staff received clearly inadequate safety training, so mistakes increased sharply during the busiest weeks of summer. (新員工接受的安全訓練明顯不足，因此在夏季最忙的幾週錯誤急遽增加。)
The stone keystone of the old arch had cracked seriously, threatening the whole gateway carefully built above the road. (老拱門的石製基石嚴重裂開，威脅整座小心翼翼建在道路上方的門樓。)

meaning: adj. 明顯的 vt. 表明；顯示 n. 貨物清單
example: The clear symptoms became manifest only after several days, unfortunately delaying the final diagnosis by almost a week. (明顯症狀過了幾天後才顯現，不幸使最終診斷延誤了將近一週。)
Overall sales improved only marginally last quarter, so senior managers decided to quickly change the entire advertising strategy. (上季整體銷售僅稍微改善，因此資深經理決定迅速改變整個廣告策略。)

meaning: adv. 適度地；不過分地；有節制地
example: Regular moderately intense exercise several times a week can greatly improve heart health without ever leaving you completely exhausted. (每週幾次適度激烈運動能大大改善心臟健康，又不會讓你筋疲力盡。)

meaning: adj. 顯而易見的；明顯的
example: There was a clear noticeable change in her accent, suggesting she had probably lived abroad for quite a few years. (她的口音有明顯改變，顯示她很可能在國外住了好些年。)

meaning: adj. 眼的；視覺的；光學的 n. 光學儀器
example: The optic nerve carries visual signals quickly to the brain, allowing us to recognise familiar faces and colours clearly. (視神經迅速把視覺訊號傳到腦部，讓我們能清楚辨認熟悉的臉孔和顏色。)

meaning: vt. 比……重；比……更重要；勝過
example: The convenience of online shopping may clearly outweigh its hidden costs for busy parents with very little time. (對時間極少的忙碌父母而言，網購的便利可能明顯大於其隱藏成本。)
Long-term investment in local rural broadband would clearly help small businesses, although the benefits appear only rather slowly. (對當地鄉村寬頻的長期投資明顯有助小企業，儘管效益浮現得相當緩慢。)

meaning: adj. 不利的；有害的；敵對的
example: Adverse weather conditions delayed the construction of the new school by weeks. (惡劣天氣使新學校的工程延誤數週。)
The festival ended with a grand spectacular finale, lighting the entire sky above the river for twenty minutes. (慶典以盛大壯觀的終曲結束，照亮河上整片天空二十分鐘。)
The child's ability to solve complex puzzles astonished even her experienced teachers. (這孩子解開複雜謎題的能力，連經驗豐富的老師都驚訝。)

meaning: n. 費用；指控；電荷 v. 收費
example: The repair shop made no extra charge for the small simple adjustment, which clearly pleased the customer greatly. (修理店沒對這項簡單的小調整收取額外費用，明顯讓顧客非常高興。)
The course is divided into six modules, each ending with a short test. (這門課分為六個單元，每個單元結束都有小測驗。)
The tired press corps followed the candidate closely everywhere, recording every single campaign speech and awkward public moment. (疲倦的記者團貼身跟著候選人四處跑，記錄每一場競選演說和每個尷尬的公開時刻。)
The country's economy still depends heavily on petroleum exports and related industries. (該國經濟仍高度依賴石油出口及相關產業。)
Hot magma rose slowly beneath the volcano for weeks before the eruption began. (火山爆發前，高溫岩漿在火山下方緩慢上升數週。)
They carefully furnished the flat with a few stylish old pieces, mixing modern lighting with comfortable worn chairs. (他們用幾件時髦舊家具仔細布置公寓，把現代燈光與舒適的磨損椅子混搭。)

meaning: vt. 傾卸；傾倒 n. 垃圾場
example: Someone unfortunately dumped an old sofa beside the quiet road, blocking a large part of the entire narrow pavement. (有人不幸把舊沙發丟在安靜路邊，擋住整條窄人行道的一部分。)
Workers cleared the debris left by the storm from the main road. (工人清除風暴留在主要道路上的殘骸。)

meaning: n. 反話；諷刺；出人意料的事情
example: The irony is that the sleep app kept him awake, as bright notifications constantly arrived throughout the night. (諷刺的是，那個睡眠應用程式讓他睡不著，因為明亮通知整晚不斷送來。)

meaning: n. 成分；零部件 adj. 構成的
example: A small missing component halted critical entire production, revealing clearly how fragile the supply chain had suddenly become. (一個小小的缺件讓整個關鍵生產停擺，清楚顯示供應鏈已變得多麼脆弱。)

meaning: n. 實地調查；野外考察
example: The geologist's fieldwork took her to dangerous remote volcanoes, where she carefully collected valuable rock samples for analysis. (這位地質學家的實地調查帶她到危險的偏遠火山，她在那里仔細採集有價值的岩石樣本。)
Each applicant must provide two references and a copy of their degree. (每位申請人必須提供兩封推薦信和學位證書副本。)

meaning: n. 帶子 vt. 捆紮；包紮
example: The old leather strap on his watch broke loose, so he carried it in his front pocket all week. (他手錶的舊皮帶鬆脫斷裂，因此整週都把手錶放在前口袋。)

meaning: adj. 基礎的；基本的；根本的 n. 基本原理
example: Access to clean water is a fundamental human right, not a luxury. (取得乾淨用水是基本人權，不是奢侈品。)
The final conclusion of the argument was obviously clear, yet the supporting evidence remained still quite surprisingly weak. (這項論證的最終結論明顯清楚，但支持證據仍出乎意料地薄弱。)
The unexpected intensity of the storm surprised forecasters and caused widespread flooding. (風暴出乎意料的強度讓預報員驚訝，並造成大範圍淹水。)

meaning: adj. 值得注意的；顯著的；傑出的 n. 名人
example: There is one clear notable exception to the single rule, which the official manual mentions only quite briefly. (這條規則有一個明顯的例外，官方手冊只相當簡短地提到。)

meaning: vt. 實施；貫徹；執行 n. 工具
example: The primary school will implement the new reading programme from September onwards. (這所小學將從九月起實施新的閱讀計畫。)
A small ferry carries visitors to the isle three times a day. (一艘小型渡輪每天載訪客到小島三次。)
The major serious accident damaged a cervical vertebra, unfortunately leaving him in constant pain for several long painful months. (這場重大意外傷到一節頸椎，不幸讓他持續疼痛了好幾個月。)

meaning: n. 情節；陰謀；小塊土地
example: The novel's plot moves quickly and smoothly between wartime Shanghai and modern Taipei. (這本小說的情節在戰時上海與現代台北之間快速流暢地轉換。)
New staff spend a full week acquainting themselves with the laboratory's safety rules. (新進人員花整整一週熟悉實驗室的安全規則。)

meaning: n. 暴力行為；激烈；猛烈
example: The film shows the terrible violence of war without ever glorifying it. (這部電影呈現戰爭的可怕暴力，卻從不美化它。)
The earth revolves around the sun once every three hundred and sixty-five days. (地球每三百六十五天繞太陽一圈。)

meaning: n. 素食者 adj. 素食的
example: The restaurant offers a separate menu for vegetarians, vegans and anyone avoiding dairy. (這家餐廳為素食者、純素者和避免乳製品的人提供獨立菜單。)
The ratio of teachers to students in this small school is unusually low. (這所小學的師生比異常低。)

meaning: v. 尖叫 n. 尖叫聲
example: A sudden loud scream came from the roller coaster, mixing real fear with clearly delighted and almost wild excitement. (雲霄飛車傳來一聲突然尖叫，混合真實恐懼與明顯狂喜的興奮。)

meaning: adj. 陡峭的；過高的；急劇的
example: The sudden steep rise in local housing prices has pushed many young families towards increasingly distant and expensive suburbs. (當地房價突然急劇上漲，把許多年輕家庭推向越來越遠的郊區。)

meaning: adj. 內部的；裡面的 n. 內部；內地
example: The hotel's carefully planned interior design blends dark wood with soft lighting, creating a genuinely warm welcoming atmosphere. (飯店細心規劃的室內設計融合深色木材與柔和燈光，營造真正溫暖友善的氣氛。)
The bat's wing is clearly analogous to a human hand, though it serves a quite entirely different purpose. (蝙蝠的翅膀明顯與人手類似，儘管用途完全不同。)
Her grandmother's old cookery book contains faded but still clearly useful handwritten notes beside almost every single recipe. (她祖母的舊烹調書在幾乎每一道食譜旁，都有褪色但依然清楚有用的手寫筆記。)
The city hopes to attract major high-tech industry, offering generous tax breaks and modern new research facilities nearby. (這座城市希望吸引大型高科技產業，提供優惠稅賦減免和附近現代化的新研究設施。)

meaning: adj. 侵犯的；侵略的；挑釁的；有進取心的
example: The dog suddenly became aggressive near food, so its worried owners always hired a local professional trainer immediately. (這隻狗在食物附近突然變得有攻擊性，因此憂心的飼主總是立刻請當地專業訓練師。)

meaning: n. 過程；步驟 vt. 加工；處理
example: The official visa process took six weeks, mostly because one simple single document had been clearly uploaded incorrectly. (官方簽證過程花了六週，主要是因為一份簡單文件明顯上傳錯誤。)

meaning: n. 嗡嗡聲；嘈雜聲 vi. 哼曲子；發嗡嗡聲
example: The low hum of the old refrigerator kept me awake all night. (冰箱低沉的嗡嗡聲讓我整晚睡不著。)

meaning: adj. 不吉祥的；凶兆的；險惡的；邪惡的
example: A sinister anonymous message suddenly appeared on her phone, warning her to stop asking any further frightening questions. (一則險惡的匿名訊息突然出現在她手機上，警告她別再問令人害怕的問題。)
The latest refinement of the engine uses less fuel and runs more quietly. (這款引擎的最新改良版更省油，運轉也更安靜。)
Local residents showed strong solidarity by helping neighbours whose homes had been flooded. (當地居民展現強大團結，幫助住家淹水的鄰居。)

meaning: n. 提綱；輪廓；草圖 vt. 概述
example: The first paragraph clearly outlines the main argument of the whole essay. (第一段清楚概述整篇文章的主要論點。)
The blank screen stared back at him, and no amount of simply clicking restored the missing lost file. (空白螢幕回望著他，再怎麼點擊也救不回遺失的檔案。)

meaning: v. 影印 n. 影印本
example: She carefully photocopied her notes for the entire class, saving everyone a long tiring evening in the library. (她仔細為全班影印筆記，替大家省下圖書館的漫長夜晚。)

meaning: n. 附件；零件；裝飾品；幫兇
example: A useful phone holder is a surprisingly cheap accessory that makes daily long drives much safer and easier. (實用的手機架是意外便宜的配件，讓每日長途開車安全輕鬆得多。)
The dean announced that the faculty would offer two new courses next year. (院長宣布學院明年將開設兩門新課程。)
The airline agreed to compensate all passengers for the unexpected long delay. (航空公司同意就意外長時間延誤補償所有乘客。)
The old wooden chest of drawers belonged to her grandmother, so she quietly but firmly refused to sell it. (這個舊木製五斗櫃屬於她祖母，因此她低調但堅決拒絕出售。)

meaning: n. 油輪；油罐車；加油飛機
example: A large oil tanker ran aground near the coast, threatening local wildlife. (一艘大型油輪在海岸附近擱淺，威脅當地野生動物。)

meaning: vt. 捕獲；俘獲；奪取 n. 戰利品
example: The camera captured a clear rare bird mid-flight, giving researchers valuable new evidence of its unusual feeding habits. (相機捕捉到一隻清晰罕見的鳥在空中飛行，為研究人員提供牠特殊進食習慣的寶貴證據。)
In addition, the full scholarship covers accommodation, so students need not ever worry at all about their monthly rent. (另外，全額獎學金包含住宿，因此學生完全不必擔心每月房租。)

meaning: vt. 對……估計過高 n. 過高的估計
example: Many walkers seriously overestimate their speed, so they often arrive at the small mountain hut frequently after dark. (許多健行者嚴重高估自己的速度，因此常在天黑後才抵達小型山屋。)
The report begins with a short clear overview, before carefully examining each main finding in much greater detail. (報告以簡短清楚的概述開始，接著仔細逐一詳查每項主要發現。)
The scheme offers a direct clear pathway into engineering, helping young graduates without contacts finally find proper work. (這項計畫提供進入工程的明確途徑，幫助沒有背景的年輕畢業生終於找到正當工作。)
The riddle perplexed the children for hours, until a shy quiet girl suddenly gave the correct final answer. (這個謎語讓孩子們困惑了好幾小時，直到一個害羞安靜的女孩突然說出正確答案。)

meaning: n. 識別；認出；承認；賞識
example: She finally received public recognition for her patient research, after many years of quiet and largely unnoticed effort. (她的耐心研究終於獲得公開肯定，那是多年安靜且大致不受注意的努力。)
The slow careful reconstruction of the city centre took five years, replacing many old buildings destroyed during the war. (市中心緩慢仔細的重建花了五年，取代許多戰爭期間被毀的老建築。)

meaning: vt. 使得；給予；提供；翻譯
example: The sudden serious injury rendered him unable to work, so his family immediately applied for local financial support. (這場突然的嚴重傷害使他無法工作，因此家人立刻申請當地財務補助。)

meaning: n. 更新；恢復；重建；續期
example: The quiet lease renewal was suddenly refused, because the landlord wanted the entire flat for his own family. (安靜的租約續期突然被拒，因為房東想把整間公寓留給自己家人。)
The council requisitioned the old empty hotel, using it to house local families left homeless by the flood. (市議會徵用這間空置的老飯店，用來安置因洪水無家可歸的當地家庭。)

meaning: adj. 內向的；有所保留的；預訂的
example: The best table was quietly reserved for regular customers, which clearly annoyed the small group of visitors waiting outside. (最好的桌子被悄悄保留給常客，明顯讓在外等候的一小群訪客不滿。)

meaning: v. 解決；決定；分解 n. 決心
example: A skilled mediator helped resolve the bitter conflict, although both sides still remained clearly suspicious for several months. (一位熟練調解人協助解決這場激烈衝突，儘管雙方之後幾個月仍明顯互相猜疑。)

meaning: n. 麻袋；解僱；劫掠 vt. 解僱
example: The coach was sacked after a series of poor results, despite still strong support from his local players. (教練因一連串不佳成績遭解僱，儘管當地球員仍強烈支持他。)

meaning: v. 滑動；下滑 n. 滑坡；幻燈片
example: Sales began to slide steadily in autumn, forcing the small local chain to quietly close three of its stores. (秋季銷售開始穩定下滑，迫使這家小型地方連鎖店悄悄關閉三家門市。)

meaning: vi. 暴跌；突然倒下 n. 蕭條期；低潮
example: Tourism slumped suddenly during the pandemic, leaving local hotels nearly empty and thousands of skilled staff suddenly unemployed. (疫情期間觀光突然暴跌，讓當地飯店幾乎空無一人，數千名熟練員工失業。)

meaning: n. 表面；外表 v. 浮出水面；顯露
example: The surface of the moon is covered with fine dust, hiding deep rocks beneath a thick grey layer. (月球表面覆蓋細塵，把深厚岩石藏在厚重灰色層下。)

meaning: v. 發癢；使高興；逗樂 n. 癢
example: A persistent tickle in his throat made him cough constantly throughout the concert, annoying the people sitting nearby. (喉嚨持續發癢讓他整場音樂會不斷咳嗽，惹惱坐在附近的觀眾。)

meaning: n. 運輸；運輸系統；運輸工具
example: The transportation of heavy goods by rail is generally much cheaper than road haulage over very long distances. (鐵路運輸重型貨物通常比公路貨運在極長距離上便宜得多。)

meaning: adj. 一致同意的；一致通過的
example: The jury finally reached a unanimous verdict, although the whole long trial had lasted almost three difficult weeks. (陪審團終於達成一致裁決，儘管這場漫長審判已持續將近三個艱難星期。)

meaning: vt. 低估 n. 低估
example: The young team clearly underestimated their local opponents, and lost the match despite dominating the entire first half. (這支年輕球隊明顯低估對手，儘管掌控整個上半場仍輸掉比賽。)

meaning: adj. 可以理解的；能懂的；可同情的
example: The small mistake was clearly understandable, since the nurses had worked for sixteen long hours without a break. (這個小錯誤完全可以理解，因為護理師已連續工作十六個長小時沒休息。)
The doctor carefully transcribed the patient's spoken comments, then quickly read them back to check their full accuracy. (醫師仔細轉錄病人的口述意見，接著迅速讀回以核對完整準確性。)
Local opinions differ completely about whether the old market should be demolished. (對於舊市場是否該拆除，當地意見截然不同。)

meaning: v. 承擔；負起責任；答應
example: The university will undertake a major study of air quality in the city. (這所大學將承擔一項城市空氣品質的大型研究。)

meaning: prep. 加上；和 n. 加號；正號
example: The rent is reasonable, plus the flat is close to the metro station. (租金合理，加上公寓靠近地鐵站。)
The small garden recycles rainwater through a simple ordinary system, greatly reducing the household's daily use of tap water. (這座小花園透過簡單系統回收雨水，大大減少家庭每日自來水用量。)

meaning: adj. 被抓住的；受控制的 n. 俘虜
example: The captive audience listened patiently, although the entire long speech had already clearly and very obviously bored them. (被迫留下的觀眾耐心聽著，儘管整場冗長演說已非常明顯地讓他們感到無聊。)
Her quiet unconquerable spirit genuinely helped her recover steadily, even when doctors offered her very little real hope. (她安靜不屈的精神真的幫助她穩定康復，即使醫師幾乎不抱任何實質希望。)

meaning: vt. 尊敬 n. 尊敬；方面
example: Good journalists always respect people's personal privacy, even when a dramatic story might clearly attract far more readers. (優秀記者總是尊重他人個人隱私，即使一則戲劇性報導明顯能吸引更多讀者。)

meaning: adj. 中立的；無明顯特性的；中立國的
example: The mediator remained neutral and listened carefully to both sides of the dispute. (調停者保持中立，仔細聆聽爭端雙方的說法。)
The campus now feels much safer at night, thanks to better street lighting and daily regular security patrols. (校園現在夜間感覺安全多了，多虧更好的路燈和每日固定巡邏。)

meaning: n. 贈送；贈品；顯示；報告
example: His important presentation to the client went well, despite his clearly obvious nerves during the first few opening minutes. (他給客戶的重要報告進行順利，儘管開頭幾分鐘明顯緊張。)
The grand official residence of the mayor stands beside the public gardens. (市長宏偉的官邸位於公園旁。)
The team's mission was to map the caves beneath the limestone hills. (這支隊伍的任務是繪製石灰岩丘陵下方的洞穴地圖。)

meaning: n. 內容；含量 adj. 滿意的 vt. 使滿意
example: The website content was clearly outdated, so the small team rewrote every single page before the major launch. (網站內容明顯過時，因此小型團隊在正式上線前重寫了每一頁。)

meaning: vt. 發出（光熱聲等）；散發；排放
example: The factory constantly emits a thin grey smoke, which local residents claim smells strongly of unpleasant industrial chemicals. (工廠不斷排放稀薄灰煙，當地居民聲稱聞起來有強烈的工業化學品味。)
The health clinic offers a free pamphlet about healthy eating for young families. (健康診所提供一本關於年輕家庭健康飲食的免費小冊子。)
The builder gave us a written assurance that the roof would be repaired. (建商向我們提出書面保證，屋頂會修好。)
The research laboratory bought new equipment for measuring local air and water quality. (研究實驗室採購了新設備，用來測量當地空氣與水質。)
The small classroom hamster escaped its cage, and the children quietly searched every corner before eventually finding it asleep. (教室的小倉鼠逃出籠子，孩子們悄悄搜遍每個角落，最後才發現牠睡著了。)

meaning: adj. 明智的；合情理的；能覺察到的
example: She quietly wore flat sensible shoes to the wedding, knowing the reception would be held on soft grass. (她悄悄穿平底實用的鞋去婚禮，知道婚宴將在柔軟草地上舉行。)
The unmanned spacecraft sent back remarkably detailed images of the planet's icy surface. (這艘無人太空船傳回該行星冰凍表面極為詳細的影像。)
One consequence of his career decision was a sudden move abroad, which clearly surprised all his former colleagues. (他職涯決定的一個結果是突然移居國外，這明顯讓所有前同事驚訝。)

meaning: adj. 有效的；效率高的；有能力的
example: The young worker is remarkably efficient, simply finishing tasks that once took hours in only half the time. (這位年輕員工效率驚人，把以前要花數小時的任務簡簡單單用一半時間完成。)

meaning: adj. 流通的；現行的 n. 水流；電流
example: The current situation is clearly unsatisfactory, so the committee will review funding for local rural transport next month. (目前情況明顯不理想，因此委員會下月將檢討當地鄉村運輸的經費。)
A temperature inversion trapped damp cold air in the low valley, keeping the thick fog there all morning. (逆溫層把濕冷空氣困在低窪山谷，讓濃霧整個早上都留在那裡。)

meaning: vt. 提升；舉起；使更有修養
example: Regular reading can elevate a child's vocabulary and confidence in academic writing. (規律閱讀能提升孩子的字彙量與學術寫作信心。)
She finally repaid her small student loan early, saving a considerable amount in regular monthly interest payments overall. (她終於提早還清小額學貸，在每月利息支出上省下可觀金額。)
She is more than capable of managing the project without any outside help. (她完全有能力在沒有任何外援下管理這個專案。)

meaning: n. 演出；表演；履行；效能
example: His exam performance unfortunately suffered badly, mainly because he had clearly slept so very little the night before. (他的考試表現不幸嚴重受影響，主要是因為前一晚明顯睡得太少。)

meaning: adj. 殘廢的；有生理缺陷的
example: The new lift makes the old building accessible to physically handicapped visitors. (新電梯讓這棟舊建築對肢體障礙訪客也能通行無阻。)

meaning: vt. 使絕緣；隔熱；隔音；隔離
example: Thick stone walls insulate the house against summer heat and winter cold. (厚石牆讓房子隔絕夏熱冬寒。)

meaning: n. 家庭；全家人 adj. 家庭的；家用的
example: The average household in this city uses less water than a decade ago. (這座城市的平均家庭用水量比十年前少。)
Constant background noise is clearly detrimental to concentration, especially for young students preparing for their difficult final exams. (持續的背景噪音明顯有害專注，對準備困難考試的年輕學生尤其如此。)

meaning: v. 裝飾；裝潢；佈置；授勳

meaning: adj. 平靜的；平和的；太平洋的 n. 太平洋
example: The sea was unusually pacific that morning, so the fishermen set out early. (那天早上海面異常平靜，漁民因此提早出海。)
Plastic waste in the ocean breaks down into tiny pieces that enter the food chain. (海洋中的塑膠垃圾分解成微小碎片，進入食物鏈。)

meaning: adj. 海洋的；海生的；海事的 n. 水兵
example: Marine pollution threatens fish stocks and the livelihoods of many coastal communities. (海洋汙染威脅魚類資源和沿海社區的生計。)
Hotels line the gulf, attracting divers who come to explore the coral reefs. (海灣沿岸飯店林立，吸引潛水客前來探索珊瑚礁。)
The council cleans the beach every morning during the busy summer season. (夏季旺季期間，議會每天早上都會清理海灘。)
The new railway will link inland cities to the coast and reduce road traffic. (這條新鐵路將連接內陸城市與海岸，並減少道路交通。)
The fishing boats return to the harbour with the tide every afternoon. (漁船每天下午隨著潮汐返回港口。)
A narrow brook runs through the village and supplies water to several gardens. (一條小溪流經村莊，為幾座花園供水。)
The path was rough and uneven, so walkers needed strong waterproof boots. (那條小路粗糙不平，登山者需要穿堅固的靴子。)
The children ran barefoot across the sandy beach towards the shallow water. (孩子們跑過鋪滿沙的海灘，奔向淺水處。)
The stony ground made it difficult to plant anything without heavy machinery. (多石的地面讓人在沒有機械的情況下很難種植作物。)
The narrow street was never designed for the number of cars using it today. (這條狹窄街道當初設計時，根本沒考慮到今日的車流量。)
Oceania includes thousands of islands spread across a vast area of the Pacific. (大洋洲包含數千座散布於太平洋廣大區域的島嶼。)
Many islanders move to the mainland in search of better paid work. (許多島民移居本土，尋找待遇更好的工作。)
The peninsula is popular with tourists because of its quiet beaches and walks. (這座半島因寧靜的海灘和步道而受到遊客喜愛。)
Extreme weather has become more frequent, damaging homes and disrupting transport networks. (極端天氣變得更加頻繁，損壞房屋並擾亂交通網絡。)
Rising fuel costs have made heating a serious expense for many older households. (燃料成本上漲，使供暖成為許多老年家庭的一大開銷。)

meaning: adj. 溫暖的 v. 變暖
example: Warm winters have allowed insects to survive in areas where they once died. (溫暖的冬天讓昆蟲得以在過去會凍死的區域存活。)
Diseases once confined to the tropics are now appearing in southern Europe. (過去只限於熱帶地區的疾病，現在也出現在南歐。)

meaning: adj. 乾燥的；乾旱的；枯燥的
example: Farming is difficult in arid regions where rainfall is low and unpredictable. (在降雨少且難以預測的乾燥地區，耕作十分困難。)

meaning: adj. 下雪多的；被雪覆蓋的
example: The snowy roads closed several mountain passes for most of the week. (下雪的道路使幾個山區隘口封閉了大半個星期。)
Late frost damaged the young vines and reduced this year's grape harvest. (晚霜凍傷幼藤，使今年的葡萄收成減少。)

meaning: n. 冰雹 v. 讚揚；招呼
example: Heavy hail damaged car roofs and smashed windows across the northern suburbs. (大顆冰雹損壞北方郊區的汽車車頂，並砸破窗戶。)

meaning: v. 解凍；融化 n. 解凍時期
example: The ice began to thaw as soon as warmer air reached the valley. (較暖的空氣一抵達山谷，冰就開始解凍。)

meaning: v. 結冰；凍結 n. 霜凍；嚴寒期
example: Pipes can freeze during extremely cold nights, leaving homes without running water. (寒冷的夜晚水管可能結冰，讓住家沒有自來水可用。)
Rescuers searched the frigid mountains for two climbers reported missing on Friday. (救援人員在寒冷的山區搜尋週五通報失蹤的兩名登山客。)

meaning: v. 戰慄；顫抖 n. 顫抖
example: Her hands trembled as she signed the contract after months of uncertainty. (經歷數個月的不確定後，她簽約時雙手顫抖。)
The passengers shivered on the platform while waiting for the delayed train. (乘客在月台上等誤點的火車，冷得發抖。)

meaning: n. 閃電 adj. 閃電般的；極快的
example: Lightning struck the church tower and started a small fire in the roof. (閃電擊中教堂塔樓，在屋頂引發一場小火。)

meaning: adj. 有暴風雨的；爭吵激烈的；（大海）波濤洶湧的
example: The ferry was cancelled because of stormy weather and dangerously strong winds. (由於暴風雨天氣和強風，渡輪航班取消。)
Average rainfall has fallen by a fifth since records began in 1960. (自一九六○年開始記錄以來，平均降雨量已減少五分之一。)

meaning: v. 撒；下小雨 n. 少量；小雨
example: Sprinkle a little salt over the roasted vegetables just before serving them. (上菜前在蔬菜上撒一點鹽。)
A bright rainbow appeared over the valley shortly after the storm passed. (暴風雨過後，一道明亮的彩虹出現在山谷上空。)
A brief shower caught us without umbrellas, but we soon dried off. (一陣短暫陣雨讓我們沒帶傘就淋溼了，不過很快就乾了。)

meaning: adj. 攝氏的 n. 攝氏溫度
example: Temperatures in the city reached forty degrees Celsius during last week's heatwave. (上週熱浪期間，這座城市的氣溫達到攝氏四十度。)
The average temperature in July has risen by two degrees since the 1980s. (自一九八○年代以來，七月的平均氣溫已上升兩度。)

meaning: n. 山峰；頂點 v. 達到最大值
example: Snow still covers the highest peak even in the middle of summer. (即使在盛夏，最高的山峰仍覆蓋著雪。)
The mountain attracts thousands of walkers each year, putting pressure on narrow paths. (這座山吸引數千名登山客，對狹窄步道造成壓力。)

meaning: n. 山脊；山脈 v. 使隆起
example: We followed the ridge for several hours before descending into the valley. (我們沿著山脊走了好幾個小時，才下到山谷。)
The valley floods every spring, depositing rich soil across the surrounding farmland. (這座山谷每年春天氾濫，為周圍農地沉積肥沃土壤。)
Terraces were cut into the hillside to create flat land for crops. (山坡上開闢梯田，以創造平坦的農地。)

meaning: v. 遠眺；俯瞰；未注意到
example: The hotel rooms overlook the harbour, where fishing boats arrive each morning. (飯店房間俯瞰港口，漁船每天早上都會進港。)
Southern regions enjoy milder winters but now face increasingly serious water shortages. (南部地區冬天較溫和，但現在面臨日益嚴重的缺水問題。)

meaning: n. 東南方；東南部 adj. 東南方的；東南部的
example: The southeast of the country is by far the most densely populated area. (該國東南部是人口最密集的地區。)

meaning: n. 西南方；西南部 adj. 西南方的；西南部的
example: Farmers in the southwest grow grapes and olives on carefully terraced hillsides. (西南部的農民在精心開闢的梯田山坡上種植葡萄和橄欖。)

meaning: n. 東北方；東北部 adj. 東北方的；東北部的
example: The northeast has suffered from declining industry and outward migration for decades. (東北部數十年來飽受產業衰退與人口外移之苦。)

meaning: n. 西北方；西北部 adj. 西北方的；西北部的
example: The northwest coast is known for its spectacular cliffs and unpredictable weather. (西北海岸以壯觀的懸崖和難以預測的天氣聞名。)
Eastern parts of the city have better transport links than the western suburbs. (這座城市東部的交通連結比西部郊區好。)
The museum has a fine collection of oriental ceramics from the sixteenth century. (這座博物館收藏了一批精美的十六世紀東方陶瓷。)

meaning: adj. 不可逆轉的；不可挽回的
example: Damage to the coral reef may be irreversible, even if pollution is reduced. (即使減少汙染，珊瑚礁受到的損害也可能不可逆轉。)

meaning: adv. 不規則地；不合常規地
example: Buses arrive irregularly, which makes commuting difficult for residents without their own cars. (公車到站時間不規則，讓沒有車的居民通勤很困難。)
The court ruled that the advertisement used inappropriate images of young children. (法院裁定那則廣告使用了不合適的幼童影像。)

meaning: adj. 不正常的；反常的；變態的
example: The doctor found abnormal cells and ordered further tests to rule out cancer. (醫生發現不正常的細胞，並安排進一步檢查以排除癌症。)
Heavy overnight rain left the football pitch muddy and unfit for play. (大雨讓足球場變得泥濘，不適合比賽。)
After the storm, a thick layer of dirt covered the supermarket floor. (暴風雨過後，超市地板上覆蓋著一層厚厚的汙垢。)
Housing on the outskirts is cheaper, but residents depend heavily on cars. (郊區的住宅比較便宜，但居民非常依賴汽車。)
The desolate landscape stretched for miles without a single tree or house. (荒涼的景觀延伸數英里，連一棵樹或一間房子都沒有。)
People in distant villages still travel hours to reach the nearest hospital. (偏遠村落的居民仍要花數小時才能到達最近的醫院。)

meaning: n. 邊緣；劉海 adj. 非主要的；邊緣的
example: New factories were built on the fringe of the city, close to main roads. (新工廠建在城市邊緣、靠近主要道路的地方。)
The Pacific plate moves slowly beneath the ocean floor, causing frequent earthquakes. (太平洋板塊在海底緩慢移動，導致地震頻繁。)

meaning: n. 缺口；裂縫；差距；空白
example: The gap between rich and poor has widened over the past decade. (貧富差距在過去十年間持續擴大。)
The hotel staff were super, helping us find a doctor late at night. (飯店員工服務極好，深夜還幫我們找到醫生。)
The documentary raises interesting questions about how large cities will feed themselves. (這部紀錄片提出有趣的問題：城市未來要如何養活自己。)
Large areas of wilderness have been lost to logging and mining since 1990. (自一九九○年以來，大片荒野因伐木和採礦而消失。)

meaning: v. 砍伐森林；破壞森林
example: Farmers often deforest land to grow crops, unaware of the long-term damage. (農民常砍伐森林以種植作物，卻未意識到長期的損害。)
Farmers fertilize their fields in spring to improve the quality of the soil. (農民在春天為田地施肥，以改善土壤品質。)
We left the guesthouse before sunrise to avoid the fierce midday heat. (我們在日出前離開民宿，以避開正午的高溫。)
The best views are at sunset, when the cliffs turn deep orange. (最好的景色在日落時分，懸崖會轉為深橘色。)

meaning: n. 日食；月食；黯然失色
example: Thousands gathered on the hill to watch the solar eclipse through protective glasses. (數千人聚集在山上，透過防護眼鏡觀看日食。)
The remote island feels like heaven to anyone tired of city noise. (對厭倦城市噪音的人來說，這座偏遠小島宛如天堂。)
The valley, with its clear streams and orchards, is a walker's paradise. (這座山谷有清澈溪流和果園，是健行者的樂園。)
The region enjoys long hours of sunshine, which suits grape growing very well. (這個地區日照時間長，適合種植葡萄。)
The tree cast a wide shadow over the table where we sat. (那棵樹在我們坐的桌子上投下大片影子。)
Water vapour rises from the sea and later forms clouds over the land. (水汽從海面上升，之後在陸地上空形成雲。)
The fans circulate warm air through the greenhouse on cold winter nights. (寒冷的冬夜，風扇讓暖空氣在溫室裡循環。)
Minerals precipitate from the water as it slowly cools inside the cave. (水在洞穴內慢慢冷卻時，礦物質會沉澱出來。)
The reservoir supplies drinking water to more than a million people in the region. (這座水庫供應區域內超過一百萬人的飲用水。)
A powerful waterfall marks the point where the river drops into the valley. (一道氣勢磅礴的瀑布標誌著河流落入山谷的位置。)
Morning dew covered the grass, soaking our shoes as we crossed the field. (晨露覆蓋草地，我們穿越田野時鞋子都溼了。)

meaning: v. 排空；流出；耗竭 n. 排水管
example: The workers drained the pond to remove the rubbish that had collected there. (工人把池塘的水排空，清除積在裡面的垃圾。)
The tap continued to drip all night, wasting water and keeping us awake. (水龍頭整晚一直滴水，浪費水又讓我們睡不著。)
Rising floodwater drowned livestock and destroyed most crops across the eastern lowlands. (上漲的洪水淹死牲畜，並摧毀低地的大部分農作物。)

meaning: v. 吹；打擊 n. 挫折
example: Strong winds blow from the sea every afternoon, cooling the coastal towns. (每天下午強風從海上吹來，讓沿海城鎮涼爽許多。)

meaning: v. 噴出；喘息 n. 一股；一縷
example: He puffed on his pipe while watching the boats return to harbour. (他一邊抽著菸斗、吐著煙，一邊看著船隻返回港口。)

meaning: v. 湧出 n. 湧出
example: Water gushed from the broken pipe and flooded the basement within minutes. (水從破裂的水管湧出，幾分鐘內就淹了地下室。)
Plastic bottles float on the surface and are carried far out to sea. (塑膠瓶漂浮在水面，被帶到很遠的外海。)
The surrounding hills protect the village from the strongest winter winds from the north. (周圍的山丘保護這個村莊免受最強冬季風侵襲。)
The housing situation has improved slightly since the new flats were completed. (新公寓完工後，住宅狀況已略有改善。)
Spending time in nature can reduce stress and improve concentration at work. (花時間親近自然能減輕壓力，並提升工作時的專注力。)
The laboratory stores dangerous gases in sealed containers well away from any heat. (實驗室把危險氣體存放在遠離熱源的密封容器裡。)
The price of gasoline has risen sharply, pushing up the cost of deliveries. (汽油價格急遽上漲，推高了外送與貨運成本。)
Photosynthesis allows green plants to convert sunlight into chemical energy for growth. (光合作用讓綠色植物把陽光轉換成生長所需的化學能。)
Fish respire through gills, while land animals rely on lungs and skin. (魚透過鰓呼吸，陸生動物則依賴肺和皮膚。)
She grows herbs on the balcony and uses them in almost every meal. (她在陽台種香草，幾乎每餐都會用到。)

meaning: n. 多年生植物 adj. 長期的；持久的
example: Perennials return year after year, saving gardeners both time and the cost of replanting. (多年生植物年年重新生長，為園丁節省時間和重新栽種的成本。)
She studied botany at university and later worked on crop disease research. (她大學念植物學，後來從事作物病害研究。)
Horticulture provides steady work for many families living in this fertile valley. (園藝為這座肥沃山谷的許多家庭提供穩定工作。)
Advances in genetics have made it possible to identify inherited diseases earlier. (遺傳學的進展讓人能更早發現遺傳疾病。)
A rare mutation allows some plants to survive in extremely salty soil. (一種罕見突變讓某些植物能在極鹹的土壤中存活。)
Hybridization of crops can produce varieties that resist both drought and disease. (作物雜交能培育出同時抗旱又抗病的品種。)
Farmers sow the seeds in early spring, once the frost has gone. (霜期一過，農民就在初春播種。)

meaning: v. 收割；收穫 n. 收成
example: Workers harvest the grapes by hand in order to avoid damaging the fruit. (工人用手收割葡萄，以免損傷果實。)
She plucked a ripe tomato from the vine and ate it immediately. (她從藤上摘下一顆熟番茄，當場就吃掉了。)
Visitors can pick their own apples in the orchard throughout the autumn. (秋天時，訪客可以在果園裡自己摘蘋果。)
The farmer repaired the old plough before the spring planting season began. (農民在春季播種期開始前修好犁。)

meaning: n. 耙子 v. 耙；搜尋
example: He used a rake to clear the fallen leaves from the lawn. (他用耙子清除草坪上的落葉。)
She carried a bundle of firewood up the hill to the cottage. (她抱了一束柴火上山，回到小屋。)
A tall vase of flowers stood on the table by the window. (窗邊桌上擺著一個插滿花的高花瓶。)
The room gets plenty of sunlight in the morning, so plants thrive there. (這個房間早上陽光充足，所以植物長得很好。)
Chrysanthemums are short-day plants that flower as the nights grow longer in autumn. (菊花是短日照植物，會在夜晚變長時開花。)
Shade-tolerant species can grow beneath tall trees where little light reaches them. (耐陰的物種能在光線不易到達的高大樹木下生長。)
A fungus has attacked the trees, and many have lost their leaves. (一種真菌侵襲這些樹木，許多樹都掉光了葉子。)

meaning: n. 黴菌；模子 v. 塑造；發黴
example: Damp conditions in the flat encouraged mould to grow on the bedroom walls. (公寓潮溼的環境促使黴菌在臥室牆上生長。)

meaning: n. 花粉 v. 授粉
example: Pollen from the fields causes breathing problems for many people in spring. (田野的花粉在春天讓許多人出現呼吸問題。)
The seed needs warmth and moisture before it can begin to grow. (種子需要溫度和水分才能開始生長。)

meaning: n. 花；開花植物 v. 開花；繁榮
example: This tropical flower opens in the morning and closes again at dusk. (這種花在早晨開放，黃昏時又閉合。)

meaning: v. 開花 n. 花朵
example: The cherry trees blossom in early April, attracting visitors from nearby cities. (櫻花樹在四月初開花，吸引附近城市的遊客前來。)
The whole kitchen smelled of aromatic spices that reminded her of home. (廚房瀰漫著芳香的香料味，讓她想起家鄉。)
Bananas ripen much faster when they are stored next to other fruit. (香蕉和其他水果放在一起時熟得更快。)

meaning: n. 水果 v. 結果實
example: Fresh fruit is expensive in winter, so many families buy frozen varieties. (冬天新鮮水果很貴，許多家庭因此購買冷凍水果。)
The young plants withered during the drought despite the farmer's daily efforts. (儘管農民每天努力照料，幼苗仍在乾旱中枯萎。)
The rainforest absorbs enormous amounts of carbon and supports many rare species. (雨林吸收大量碳，並孕育許多稀有物種。)
Workers on the tea plantation earn low wages and live in simple housing. (茶園工人薪資低，住在簡陋的房舍裡。)
The field has been left uncultivated for years and is now full of wild flowers. (這片原野已荒廢多年，現在長滿野花。)
The company redesigned its logo to appear more modern and environmentally friendly. (公司重新設計標誌，讓它看起來更現代、更環保。)
Forestry provides valuable employment in rural areas but must be managed sustainably. (林業為鄉村地區提供寶貴的就業機會，但必須以永續方式經營。)
A heavy bough fell across the road during the storm, blocking traffic. (暴風雨期間一根粗大樹枝倒在路上，阻斷交通。)

meaning: n. 根；詞根 v. 生根
example: The tree's roots spread widely and damage the pavement outside the house. (這棵樹的根向四周蔓延，損壞屋外的人行道。)
The farmer stored hay in the barn to feed the animals through winter. (農民把乾草存放在穀倉，供動物過冬食用。)
Tall reeds line both sides of the riverbank, providing shelter for nesting birds. (高聳的蘆葦沿河岸生長，為築巢的鳥類提供庇護。)
A thorn pierced his glove as he cut back the overgrown hedge. (他修剪過長的樹籬時，一根刺刺穿了他的手套。)
The grass in the park is cut only twice a year to save money. (為了省錢，公園的草一年只修剪兩次。)
The lawn in front of the museum is often used for summer concerts. (博物館前的草坪常用來舉辦夏季音樂會。)
Olive trees grow particularly well on the dry hillsides around the Mediterranean. (橄欖樹在地中海周圍乾燥的山坡上長得很好。)
The vine produces small grapes that are used to make a local wine. (這株葡萄藤長出的小葡萄，被用來釀造當地葡萄酒。)

Scientists developed a new method for testing water quality in remote areas. (科學家開發出一種在偏遠地區檢測水質的新方法。)
The antenna on the roof receives signals from satellites orbiting the earth. (屋頂上的天線接收來自環繞地球衛星的訊號。)
A fault in the electrical circuit caused the lights to fail suddenly. (電路故障導致燈光突然熄滅。)
Refraction of light through water makes objects appear closer than they are. (光在水中折射，會讓物體看起來比實際更近。)

meaning: n. 紫外線；紫外輻射 adj. 紫外線的
example: Ultraviolet radiation can damage the skin, so sunscreen is essential in summer. (紫外線輻射會傷害皮膚，因此夏天一定要擦防曬。)
Radioactive waste from power plants must be stored safely for thousands of years. (發電廠產生的放射性廢料必須安全存放數千年。)

meaning: adj. 可辨別的；看得清的
example: The difference between the two treatments was barely discernible to most patients. (對大多數病患而言，兩種療法之間的差異幾乎無法辨別。)
A cataclysmic earthquake changed the course of the river in a single night. (一場災難性的地震在一夜之間改變了河道。)
The evidence in favour of the new policy was overwhelming, so it passed easily. (支持新政策的證據具壓倒性，因此輕易通過。)

meaning: v. 絕望 n. 絕望
example: Many residents began to despair as the floodwaters rose for a third day. (洪水上漲到第三天，許多居民開始感到絕望。)
Without proper funding, the whole project is hopeless and should be abandoned. (沒有適當的經費，這個計畫毫無希望，應該放棄。)
Access to education remains unequal between rural and urban areas of the country. (該國城鄉之間的教育機會仍然不平等。)
The university has opened a new campus to accommodate growing student numbers. (這所大學啟用新校區，以容納不斷增加的學生人數。)
She studied engineering at a technical college before joining the company full time. (她進入公司前，曾在一所技術學院攻讀工程。)

meaning: n. 專科院校；私立學校；學會；研究院
example: The national academy of sciences advises the government on research funding and policy. (國家科學院就研究經費與政策向政府提供建議。)
Children learn languages more easily than adults, especially before the age of ten. (兒童學語言比成人容易，尤其是在十歲以前。)

meaning: v. 學習；研究 n. 學習；研究
example: Researchers study how poor sleep affects memory and concentration in older adults. (研究人員研究睡眠如何影響年長者的記憶與專注力。)
Practical knowledge of first aid can save lives in a serious emergency. (實用的急救知識能在緊急情況下救人一命。)

meaning: n. 專業知識；專門技能
example: The hospital lacks the expertise needed to treat this rare condition locally. (這家醫院缺乏在當地治療這種罕見疾病所需的專業知識。)
Illiteracy remains stubbornly high in remote areas where few schools are available. (在學校很少的偏遠地區，文盲比例仍然很高。)

meaning: adj. 識數的；有計算能力的
example: Employers prefer candidates who are numerate and comfortable working with basic data. (雇主偏好有計算能力、能自在處理基本數據的求職者。)
The city faces a serious problem with rubbish collection during holiday periods. (這座城市在假期期間面臨嚴重的垃圾收集問題。)
The minister resigned after details of the affair appeared in the press. (緋聞細節在媒體曝光後，那名部長辭職了。)

meaning: n. 難題；謎 v. 使迷惑
example: The disappearance of the bees remains a puzzle that scientists are still studying. (蜜蜂消失仍是個難題，科學家還在研究。)
The ancient riddle was carved into the stone wall of the temple. (這則古老的謎語被刻在寺廟的牆上。)

meaning: adj. 模糊的；難以理解的
example: The instructions were so obscure that few users could follow them at all. (這些說明難以理解，很少有使用者能照著做。)

meaning: v. 逐漸灌輸；諄諄教導
example: Good teachers instil curiosity in their pupils rather than simply demanding answers. (好的老師會逐漸灌輸學生好奇心，而不只是要求答案。)

meaning: v. 塞進；臨時死記硬背
example: Some students cram the night before an exam and forget most of it afterwards. (有些學生考前臨時死記硬背，考完後幾乎全忘光。)
The report emphasises the need for cleaner public transport in major cities. (這份報告強調大城市需要更潔淨的大眾運輸。)
She found a clever way to reduce waste without increasing production costs. (她找到一個聰明的辦法，在不增加生產成本的情況下減少浪費。)

meaning: adj. 全面的；多才多藝的
example: Many employers value all-round ability more than a single narrow technical skill. (許多雇主重視多才多藝的能力，勝過單一狹窄的技術。)
The design is the work of a genius who understood both art and engineering. (這項設計出自一位兼具藝術與工程理解力的天才。)
Only an idiot would drive through a flooded road at that speed. (只有傻瓜才會用那種速度開車穿越淹水的道路。)
Traditional wisdom about the weather is often supported by years of careful observation. (關於天氣的傳統智慧，往往有仔細觀察作為依據。)

meaning: n. 機智；風趣；機智的人；智慧
example: Her wit made the long meeting feel much shorter than it was. (她的機智讓冗長的會議感覺比實際短了許多。)
He received an award for outstanding service to the local community last year. (他去年因對當地社區的傑出服務而獲獎。)
The university has gained considerable international prestige through its medical research programme. (這所大學透過醫學研究獲得可觀的國際聲望。)
Diligent workers often receive better pay and more opportunities for promotion than others. (勤奮的員工往往比其他人獲得更好的待遇和更多升遷機會。)
Coding has become a basic skill for many jobs outside the technology sector. (寫程式已成為科技業以外許多工作的基本技能。)
The professor has spent twenty years studying the effects of urban noise. (這位教授花了二十年研究都市噪音的影響。)
Scientists are developing new crops that can survive longer periods without rain. (科學家正在培育能度過更長無雨期的新作物。)
The lecturer used real case studies to explain how financial markets behave. (講師用實際案例說明金融市場的運作方式。)
A degree in economics is no longer a guarantee of a well-paid job. (經濟學學位已不再是高薪工作的保證。)
Nurses must qualify before they are allowed to work in public hospitals. (護理師必須取得資格，才能在公立醫院工作。)
You need a licence to operate a drone near airports or crowded areas. (在機場或擁擠地區附近操作無人機需要有執照。)

meaning: n. 許可證 v. 允許；准許
example: The council granted a permit for the music festival despite local objections. (儘管當地有人反對，議會仍核發音樂祭的許可證。)

meaning: n. 外交官；善於交際的人
example: A skilled diplomat can ease tensions between countries without any public confrontation. (老練的外交官能在不公開對抗的情況下緩和國家間的緊張。)
Each pupil receives a tablet, which has changed the way lessons are taught. (每位小學生都拿到一台平板，改變了上課教學的方式。)

meaning: n. 碩士；大師 v. 精通；控制
example: She completed a master's degree while working full time at the bank. (她在銀行全職工作的同時，完成了碩士學位。)
The doctor advised him to reduce salt and take more regular exercise. (醫生建議他減少鹽分攝取，並多做規律運動。)
Freshers often find the first term at university both exciting and difficult. (大一新生常覺得大學第一學期既興奮又困難。)

meaning: n. （美國大學或高中）二年級學生
example: As a sophomore, he joined the debating society and made several close friends. (大二那年，他加入辯論社，交了幾個好朋友。)

meaning: n. （美國大學或高中）三年級學生；較年幼者 adj. 青少年的；地位較低的
example: Junior staff are encouraged to speak honestly during the weekly team meeting. (公司鼓勵基層員工在每週團隊會議中坦率發言。)

meaning: n. 畢業生；校友（alumnus 的複數）
example: Alumni of the college donated money to build a new sports centre. (學院校友捐款興建一座新的運動中心。)

meaning: adj. 男女同校的 n. （男女同校的）女生
example: The school became coed in the 1970s, admitting boys for the first time. (這所學校在一九七○年代改為男女同校，首次招收男生。)

meaning: n. 花名冊；登記表；執勤表
example: The duty roster is posted online so that staff can plan their weekends. (執勤表公布在網路上，讓員工可以規劃週末。)
More than five hundred adults enrolled in evening classes at the centre. (超過五百名成年人報名該中心的夜間課程。)

meaning: n. 大學入學註冊；錄取
example: Matriculation marks the formal start of a student's university career in many countries. (在許多國家，大學入學註冊象徵學生大學生活的正式開始。)
The dining hall serves hot meals to residents at low prices every day. (餐廳每天以低價為住民提供熱食。)
The laboratory is equipped with instruments for analysing air and water samples. (這間實驗室配備了分析空氣與水樣本的儀器。)
The experiment clearly showed that the plant grew faster under blue light. (這項實驗顯示，那種植物在藍光下生長得更快。)
The quality of air in the city has improved since diesel buses were replaced. (自從柴油公車汰換後，這座城市的空氣品質已改善。)
The library extends its opening hours during the examination period each year. (圖書館每年考試期間都會延長開放時間。)
The article examines why so many young people are leaving rural towns. (這篇文章探討為何有這麼多年輕人離開鄉鎮。)
The author spent five years interviewing families affected by the factory closure. (作者花了五年訪問受工廠關閉影響的家庭。)
The film is a cautionary tale about the dangers of unchecked ambition. (這部電影是一個關於野心不受控制之危險的警世故事。)

meaning: n. 故事；小說；（尤指口頭的）敘述
example: Her story of recovery after the accident inspired many readers of the magazine. (她在事故後康復的故事，激勵了許多雜誌讀者。)
He kept a diary during his travels and later published it as a book. (他在旅行期間寫日記，後來集結成書出版。)
She reads poetry before bed because it helps her relax after work. (她睡前讀詩，因為那能幫她下班後放鬆。)
The magazine publishes a monthly survey of house prices across the country. (這本雜誌每月刊登全國房價調查。)
The free online encyclopedia is updated by volunteers from around the world. (這套免費線上百科全書由世界各地的志工更新。)

meaning: n. 紀錄片 adj. 紀錄的
example: The documentary follows three families rebuilding their homes after the devastating earthquake. (這部紀錄片記錄三個家庭在毀滅性地震後重建家園的過程。)
Keep a record of your spending so that you can see where money goes. (記下你的支出，才能看出錢花到哪裡去。)

meaning: n. 檔案；文件 v. 歸檔
example: All applications are kept in a secure file for at least five years. (所有申請文件都會存放在安全檔案中至少五年。)

meaning: n. 索引；指數 v. 為……編索引
example: The index at the back of the book helps readers find topics quickly. (書後的索引幫助讀者快速找到主題。)
The museum catalogue lists every object in the collection with a short description. (博物館目錄列出館藏中的每件物品，並附簡短說明。)

meaning: n. 一覽表；目錄 v. 列舉；列表
example: The council published a list of streets where parking will be restricted. (議會公布了一份將限制停車的街道一覽表。)

meaning: n. （書的）章；（人生或歷史的）重要時刻
example: The final chapter of the report discusses how the findings should be used. (報告的最後一章討論這些研究結果應如何應用。)
